risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified, including segment trends, earnings ranges, capital expenditures, dividends, and identified operating risks. The tone is cautiously optimistic but acknowledges declining sales, commodity-price pressure, production disruption, higher SG&A, and macroeconomic sensitivity. Forward-looking results depend on multiple assumptions, while repeated emphasis on adjusted non-GAAP performance and the T&M initiative may soften comparability with GAAP outcomes.
